name: Andrej Karpathy
bio: Former Tesla AI director and OpenAI founding member. Creator of micrograd, nanoGPT, and the famous 'Neural Networks: Zero to Hero' YouTube series. Writes clearly about AI internals.

name: Simon Willison
domain: open source tools / LLM tooling / Python
bio: Creator of Datasette and co-creator of Django. Prolific blogger on LLM tooling, SQLite, and open source. Runs llm CLI tool project.

name: Linus Torvalds
bio: Creator of the Linux kernel and Git. Oversees Linux kernel development. Known for direct communication style and deep systems expertise.

name: Geoffrey Hinton
domain: deep learning / neural networks / AI safety
bio: Turing Award winner and godfather of deep learning. Left Google in 2023 to speak freely about AI risks. Pioneer of backpropagation and Boltzmann machines.

name: Yann LeCun
domain: deep learning / computer vision / AI research
bio: Chief AI Scientist at Meta and NYU professor. Pioneer of convolutional neural networks. Vocal critic of AGI doomers. Creator of the MNIST dataset.

name: François Chollet
bio: Creator of Keras and AI researcher at Google. Author of 'Deep Learning with Python'. Created the ARC benchmark to measure general intelligence.

name: Jeremy Howard
bio: Co-founder of fast.ai. Made deep learning accessible through top-down teaching. Built ULMFiT, a transfer learning method that influenced BERT.

name: Rachel Thomas
bio: Co-founder of fast.ai and founding director of USF Center for Applied Data Ethics. Writes about AI bias, diversity in tech, and practical ML.

name: Sebastián Raschka
bio: Staff research engineer at Lightning AI. Author of 'Machine Learning with PyTorch and Scikit-Learn'. Writes extensively on LLM training and fine-tuning.

name: Chip Huyen
bio: Author of 'Designing Machine Learning Systems'. Lectures at Stanford. Co-founder of Claypot AI. Writes the newsletter HUYENTECH on ML in production.

name: Swyx (Shawn Wang)
bio: Founder of AI Engineer Foundation. Former Temporal and AWS. Coined 'learn in public'. Runs the Latent Space podcast on AI engineering.

name: Harrison Chase
bio: CEO and co-founder of LangChain. Built the most widely used LLM orchestration framework. Focused on agentic AI systems and LLM application development.

name: Mikhail Parakhin
bio: Former CEO of Bing and head of Bing AI at Microsoft. Led integration of GPT-4 into Bing search. Deep background in search and AI product.

name: Hamel Husain
bio: Independent AI consultant. Previously GitHub, Airbnb, and fast.ai. Expert on LLM evaluation pipelines and productionising ML. Creator of nbdev.

name: Elvis Saravia
bio: AI researcher and educator. Runs DAIR.AI (Democratizing AI Research). Author of the widely-shared Prompt Engineering Guide. Writes about NLP advances.

name: Nathan Lambert
bio: Researcher at AllenAI (AI2). Expert on RLHF and reward modeling. Maintains the RLHF reading list. Previously HuggingFace. Writes newsletter Interconnects.

name: Tim Dettmers
domain: LLM quantization / efficient ML / GPU computing
bio: PhD researcher known for bitsandbytes and QLoRA. Made 4-bit LLM quantization practical. Deep expertise in GPU memory optimization and low-bit training.

name: Yannic Kilcher
bio: ML researcher and YouTuber who explains cutting-edge AI papers. CTO of DeepJudge. Known for clear and often opinionated breakdowns of ML research.

name: Shreya Shankar
bio: PhD student at UC Berkeley. Researcher on ML pipeline reliability and data validation. Creator of Giskard. Writes about ML failures in production.

name: Bryan Bischof
bio: Head of AI at Weights & Biases. Author of 'Building Production Recommendation Systems'. Expert in scaling data platforms and ML infrastructure.

name: Eugene Yan
bio: Senior applied scientist at Amazon. Writes eugeneyan.com on ML engineering, recommenders, and writing. Known for practical, experience-driven ML advice.

name: Jason Liu
bio: Creator of Instructor, the most popular Python library for structured LLM outputs. Independent AI consultant. Former Stitch Fix. Blogs on practical LLM patterns.

name: Dan Becker
bio: Former Kaggle and Google. Creator of multiple Kaggle courses on ML and deep learning. Expert on gradient boosting and tabular ML.

name: Vicki Boykis
bio: Senior ML engineer at Mozilla AI. Writes Vicki's newsletter on the unglamorous reality of ML work. Author of 'What are embeddings'. Known for grounded, honest ML takes.

name: Lilian Weng
domain: AI safety / deep learning / research writing
bio: VP of Safety at OpenAI. Writes the widely-read lilianweng.github.io blog covering RL, LLMs, and diffusion models. Known for thorough, well-structured technical posts.

name: Chris Olah
bio: Research scientist at Anthropic. Pioneer of neural network interpretability and visualisation. Creator of distill.pub. Famous for circuits work understanding CNNs.

name: Neel Nanda
bio: Research scientist at DeepMind. Leading researcher in mechanistic interpretability. Creator of TransformerLens library. Writes extensively on understanding transformers.

name: Alex Graves
domain: sequence modeling / RNNs / deep learning research
bio: Research scientist at Google DeepMind. Invented CTC loss and Neural Turing Machines. Pioneering work on recurrent networks and attention mechanisms.

name: Ilya Sutskever
bio: Co-founder of OpenAI and SSI. Co-invented AlexNet. Key architect of GPT series. Founded Safe Superintelligence Inc after leaving OpenAI.

name: Pieter Abbeel
bio: Professor at UC Berkeley and co-founder of Covariant AI. Pioneer of learning from demonstration and model-based RL. Runs the Spinning Up RL resource.

name: Chelsea Finn
bio: Professor at Stanford. Creator of MAML (Model-Agnostic Meta-Learning). Research on robots that learn from few examples and adapt to new tasks quickly.

name: Oriol Vinyals
bio: VP of Research at Google DeepMind. Co-creator of seq2seq, attention mechanisms, and AlphaStar. Pioneering work on pointer networks and neural program synthesis.

name: Jacob Devlin
bio: Research scientist at Google. Lead author of BERT, one of the most influential NLP papers ever. Work on language model pre-training shaped modern NLP.

name: Percy Liang
bio: Professor at Stanford and director of CRFM (Center for Research on Foundation Models). Created HELM benchmark. Researcher on robustness and reliability of LLMs.

name: Alec Radford
bio: Research scientist at OpenAI. Lead author of GPT, GPT-2, GPT-3, and CLIP. Foundational work in large-scale unsupervised language model pre-training.

name: Dario Amodei
bio: CEO and co-founder of Anthropic. Former VP Research at OpenAI. Led development of Constitutional AI and Claude. Vocal on responsible AI scaling.

name: Amanda Askell
bio: Researcher at Anthropic working on alignment and model character. PhD in philosophy. Key contributor to Constitutional AI and Claude's character design.

name: Jan Leike
bio: Former head of alignment at OpenAI, now at Anthropic. Pioneered scalable oversight and debate as alignment techniques. Expert on RLHF and reward modeling.

name: Paul Christiano
bio: Founder of Alignment Research Center. Former OpenAI. Invented IDA (Iterated Amplification) and debate as alignment approaches. Writes densely on alignment theory.

name: Stuart Russell
bio: Professor at UC Berkeley and co-author of 'Artificial Intelligence: A Modern Approach'. Author of 'Human Compatible'. Pioneer of value alignment problem framing.

name: Yoshua Bengio
domain: deep learning / AI safety / generative models
bio: Turing Award winner and professor at Université de Montréal. Co-founder of Mila. Pioneer of deep learning and generative models. Increasingly focused on AI safety.

name: Sam Altman
bio: CEO of OpenAI. Former YC president. Overseeing development of GPT series and ChatGPT. Public voice on AGI timelines, safety, and the societal impact of AI.

name: Emad Mostaque
domain: generative AI / diffusion models / open source
bio: Founder of Stability AI. Championed open-source AI with Stable Diffusion. Vocal advocate for decentralised AI. Background in quantitative finance.

name: Robin Rombach
domain: diffusion models / image generation / computer vision
bio: Lead researcher behind Stable Diffusion and Latent Diffusion Models. PhD from LMU Munich. Core paper: 'High-Resolution Image Synthesis with Latent Diffusion Models'.

name: David Holz
domain: generative image AI / product / creativity tools
bio: Founder of Midjourney. Previously co-founder of Leap Motion. Building AI tools for human creativity and imagination. Rarely interviews but deeply thoughtful on AI art.

name: Jim Keller
domain: CPU/GPU architecture / chip design / AI hardware
bio: Legendary chip architect. Designed AMD K8, Apple A4/A5, Tesla Autopilot chip. Now CEO of Tenstorrent building AI accelerator hardware.

name: George Hotz
bio: Founder of comma.ai. First person to jailbreak iPhone and hack PS3. Building open-source self-driving stack (openpilot). Known for raw systems programming ability.

name: Lex Fridman
bio: Research scientist at MIT and host of the Lex Fridman Podcast. Researches human-robot interaction and autonomous vehicles. Interviews top AI researchers and scientists.

name: Evan Morikawa
domain: AI coding tools / developer experience / product
bio: Engineering manager at Anthropic working on Claude for coding. Previously at Notion and GitHub. Deep expertise in developer tooling and AI-assisted programming.

name: Peter Norvig
bio: Former Director of Research at Google and co-author of the definitive AI textbook. Distinguished Education Fellow at Stanford HAI. Expert on search, NLP, and rationality.

name: Andrew Ng
domain: ML education / AI for everyone / deep learning
bio: Co-founder of Coursera and deeplearning.ai. Former chief scientist at Baidu and Google Brain lead. Created the most-taken ML course ever. Champions AI literacy.

name: Fei-Fei Li
domain: computer vision / AI for good / ImageNet
bio: Professor at Stanford and co-director of HAI. Created ImageNet, which catalysed the deep learning revolution. Champions human-centred AI and diversity in tech.

name: Christopher Manning
bio: Professor at Stanford and director of Stanford NLP Group. Co-author of 'Introduction to Information Retrieval'. Pioneer of statistical and neural NLP methods.

name: Lukasz Kaiser
bio: Research scientist at OpenAI. Co-author of 'Attention Is All You Need' — the transformer paper. Also contributed to Universal Transformers and Reformer.

name: Noam Shazeer
bio: Co-founder of Character.AI and co-author of 'Attention Is All You Need'. Invented mixture-of-experts layers and multi-query attention. Legendary Google Brain alumnus.

name: Ashish Vaswani
bio: Lead author of 'Attention Is All You Need'. Founder of Essential AI. Former Google Brain. The transformer architecture he introduced underlies virtually all modern LLMs.

name: Jeff Dean
domain: distributed systems / ML infrastructure / Google Brain
bio: Senior Fellow and head of Google DeepMind. Built MapReduce, BigTable, Spanner, TensorFlow, and TPUs. One of the most impactful systems engineers in history.

name: Sasha Rush
bio: Professor at Cornell Tech and Harvard. Creator of the annotated transformer and annotated diffusion model. Writes beautifully documented ML implementations.

name: Thomas Wolf
bio: Co-founder and Chief Science Officer at HuggingFace. Built the Transformers library used by millions. Passionate advocate for open-source AI and model sharing.

name: Julien Chaumond
bio: Co-founder and CTO of HuggingFace. Built infrastructure for the ML Hub — the GitHub of AI. Background in NLP and developer experience.

name: Connor Leahy
bio: CEO of Conjecture. Co-founder of EleutherAI which created GPT-Neo and GPT-J. Vocal on existential AI risk and the need for interpretability research.

name: Stella Biderman
bio: Executive director of EleutherAI. Led development of Pythia, GPT-Neo-X and the LM Evaluation Harness. Expert on open research and LLM evaluation methodology.

name: Stability AI Research
bio: Research team at Stability AI behind Stable Diffusion and stable audio. Open-source first approach to generative model research.

name: Phil Wang (lucidrains)
bio: Prolific open-source ML developer. Reimplements cutting-edge ML papers in clean PyTorch. Over 200 repos on GitHub including implementations of transformers, diffusion, and more.

name: Karpathy (new contact)
bio: Backup entry for Andrej Karpathy — educator and researcher known for nanoGPT and Zero to Hero course.

name: Soumith Chintala
bio: Co-creator of PyTorch at Meta AI. One of the most impactful ML infrastructure engineers. Champions open-source ML tooling and ease of use for researchers.

name: Greg Brockman
bio: Co-founder and former President of OpenAI. Built OpenAI's engineering culture from scratch. Former CTO of Stripe. Deep background in infrastructure and API design.

name: Wojciech Zaremba
bio: Co-founder of OpenAI. Leads robotics and Codex research. PhD from NYU. Work on LSTM training, neural program synthesis, and dexterous robotic manipulation.

name: Aidan Gomez
bio: CEO of Cohere and co-author of 'Attention Is All You Need' (as an intern at Google Brain). Building enterprise-grade LLM infrastructure at Cohere.

name: Sara Hooker
domain: model compression / efficient ML / AI fairness
bio: VP Research at Cohere For AI. Expert on model pruning, quantization, and the interplay between efficiency and fairness in ML. Runs the Cohere For AI research lab.

name: Carlos E. Perez
domain: deep learning theory / AGI / AI philosophy
bio: Author of 'Artificial Intuition' and prolific writer on deep learning as a discipline. Writes Intuition Machine newsletter on the philosophy and theory behind AI.

name: Gwern Branwen
domain: AI forecasting / scaling laws / research synthesis
bio: Independent researcher and writer. Wrote foundational essays on GPT-3 capabilities, scaling laws, and AI timelines. Extensive self-experimentation and long-form research writing.

name: Eliezer Yudkowsky
bio: Senior researcher at MIRI. Wrote the sequences on LessWrong. Pioneer of modern AI alignment thinking. Highly pessimistic on current alignment trajectories.

name: Scott Aaronson
domain: quantum computing / computational complexity / AI safety
bio: Professor at UT Austin. Expert on quantum computing and complexity theory. Worked at OpenAI on AI safety. Writes the blog Shtetl-Optimized.

name: Gary Marcus
domain: AI criticism / cognitive science / neurosymbolic AI
bio: Professor emeritus at NYU. Vocal critic of deep learning hype. Author of 'Rebooting AI'. Argues for hybrid neurosymbolic approaches to reach robust intelligence.

name: Timnit Gebru
bio: Founder of DAIR Institute. Former Google AI ethics lead. Co-authored 'Stochastic Parrots'. Researcher on algorithmic bias, facial recognition, and AI harms.

name: Emily Bender
bio: Professor at University of Washington. Co-author of 'Stochastic Parrots'. Expert on language grounding, meaning, and the limitations of LLMs from a linguistic perspective.

name: Kate Crawford
domain: AI policy / AI harms / political economy of AI
bio: Senior Principal Researcher at Microsoft Research and co-founder of AI Now Institute. Author of 'Atlas of AI'. Researches the environmental, labour, and social costs of AI.

name: Cathy O'Neil
bio: Author of 'Weapons of Math Destruction'. Data scientist turned critic of algorithmic systems. Writes mathbabe.org on the power and dangers of mathematical models.

name: Ben Thompson
domain: tech strategy / AI business / media analysis
bio: Author of Stratechery, the premier tech strategy newsletter. Deep analysis of AI's business implications, platform dynamics, and impact on media and software.

name: Paul Graham
bio: Co-founder of Y Combinator. Creator of Hacker News. Author of influential essays on startups, programming, and thinking. Fan of Lisp and bottom-up design.

name: Patrick Collison
bio: CEO of Stripe. Co-founder with his brother John. Champions fast execution and scientific progress. Runs Arc Institute. Deep reader and thinker on progress and science.

name: John Carmack
bio: Legendary programmer behind Doom, Quake, and Wolfenstein. Former CTO of Oculus. Now working independently on AGI. Famous for clean systems code and first-principles thinking.

name: Bryan Cantrill
bio: CTO and co-founder of Oxide Computer. Created DTrace at Sun Microsystems. Passionate systems programmer and vocal advocate for Rust in systems software.

name: Antirez (Salvatore Sanfilippo)
bio: Creator of Redis. Expert in low-level C programming and data structure design. Writes reflectively about software craft, simplicity, and the joy of building.

name: Mitchell Hashimoto
bio: Co-founder of HashiCorp (Terraform, Vault, Consul). Creator of Vagrant. One of the most impactful open-source infrastructure tool authors. Deep Go expertise.

name: Kelsey Hightower
bio: Staff developer advocate at Google. Author of 'Kubernetes: Up and Running'. One of the most respected voices on cloud-native infrastructure and Kubernetes.

name: Theo Browne (t3dotgg)
bio: Creator of the T3 Stack (Next.js, tRPC, Prisma, Tailwind). YouTuber and educator on modern web development. Runs Ping.gg. Opinionated and direct communicator.

name: Kent C. Dodds
bio: Creator of Testing Library and Epic React. Former PayPal engineer. Educator on React, JavaScript testing, and web fundamentals. Runs EpicReact.dev and EpicWeb.dev.

name: Guillermo Rauch
bio: CEO of Vercel and creator of Next.js. Previously created Socket.io and Mongoose. Building the platform for modern web deployment and the Next.js ecosystem.

name: Rich Harris
bio: Creator of Svelte and Rollup. Staff engineer at Vercel. Known for rethinking frontend fundamentals — compilers over runtime, and simplicity over abstraction.

name: Ryan Dahl
bio: Creator of Node.js and Deno. Gave the famous 'Things I Regret About Node.js' talk. Building Deno as a secure, TypeScript-first JavaScript runtime.

name: Evan You
bio: Creator of Vue.js and Vite. Independent open-source developer. Built Vue from scratch while at Google. Vite has become the dominant frontend build tool.

name: Dan Abramov
bio: Co-creator of Redux and Create React App. Core React team at Meta. Known for deep, thoughtful writing on UI architecture, state management, and developer experience.

name: Armin Ronacher
bio: Creator of Flask, Jinja2, Click, and Werkzeug. Prolific Python open-source contributor. Writes thoughtfully on Python, Rust, and the craft of library design.

name: Hynek Schlawack
bio: Creator of attrs and structlog. Python core developer. Writes about software craft, Python best practices, and the philosophy of clean API design.

name: David Beazley
bio: Author of the Python Cookbook and Python Essential Reference. Expert on Python internals, concurrency, and metaprogramming. Legendary live-coding educator.

name: Raymond Hettinger
bio: Python core developer and creator of OrderedDict, namedtuple improvements, and itertools. Famous for 'Transforming Code into Beautiful, Idiomatic Python' talk at PyCon.

name: Glyph Lefkowitz
bio: Creator of Twisted, the pioneering Python async networking framework that predated asyncio. Thoughtful writer on software design, Python, and engineering culture.

name: Wes McKinney
bio: Creator of pandas and co-creator of Apache Arrow. Author of 'Python for Data Analysis'. Building Voltron Data to accelerate data infrastructure with Arrow.

name: Travis Oliphant
bio: Creator of NumPy and SciPy. Co-founder of Anaconda and Quansight. Foundational figure in the scientific Python ecosystem. PhD in Biomedical Engineering.

name: Matthew Rocklin
bio: Creator of Dask for parallel computing in Python. Works on scalable data tools at Coiled. Expert on parallel algorithms and distributed Python computation.

name: Jake VanderPlas
bio: Developer advocate at Google and creator of Altair (declarative visualisation for Python). Author of 'Python Data Science Handbook'. Former UW astronomy researcher.

name: Chris Lattner
bio: Creator of LLVM, Clang, Swift, and MLIR. Former VP at Apple and Tesla Autopilot. Now CEO of Modular building Mojo — a Python-superset for AI performance.

name: Graydon Hoare
bio: Original creator of Rust at Mozilla. Now works on Swift at Apple. Deep expertise in type systems, memory safety, and systems language design.

name: Andrew Gallant (BurntSushi)
bio: Creator of ripgrep (the fastest code search tool) and author of key Rust regex libraries. Prolific Rust open-source contributor. Known for extreme engineering rigour.

name: Jon Gjengset
bio: PhD from MIT and Rust educator. Author of 'Rust for Rustaceans'. Runs a popular YouTube channel on advanced Rust. Focuses on the internals and hard edges of Rust.

name: Amos Wenger (fasterthanlime)
bio: Independent developer and writer at fasterthanli.me. Famous for extremely detailed long-form posts on Rust, HTTP, and systems topics. Deep dive specialist.

name: Philipp Schmid
domain: LLM fine-tuning / Hugging Face / production ML
bio: Technical Lead at Hugging Face. Prolific blogger and YouTuber on LLM fine-tuning, RLHF, and deploying transformers. Very responsive to the community.

name: Omar Sanseviero
domain: ML community / Hugging Face / open-source AI
bio: Chief of ML at Hugging Face. Runs the HF community Discord. Enthusiastic about open-source models and helping developers build with AI. Very approachable.

name: Nils Reimers
bio: Creator of Sentence-Transformers library. Research lead at Hugging Face. His work on semantic embeddings is foundational to RAG and vector search pipelines.

name: Jerry Liu
bio: Co-founder and CEO of LlamaIndex. Writes extensively about RAG architectures, agentic pipelines, and LLM application patterns. Very active on Twitter.

name: Zain Hasan
bio: Developer Advocate at Weaviate. Creates tutorials and notebooks on building RAG systems with vector DBs. One of the most active voices in the vector DB space.

name: Roie Schwaber-Cohen
bio: Developer Advocate at Pinecone. Publishes accessible guides on embedding pipelines, semantic search, and production RAG. Frequently engages with the community.

name: Josh Tobin
bio: Founder of Gantry (ML observability). Previously OpenAI and UC Berkeley. Vocal about the importance of evaluation and monitoring in production ML systems.

name: Eugene Cheah
bio: Founder of Recursal AI. Leads the RWKV project, a linear-attention LLM alternative to Transformers. Passionate about efficient open-source AI. Very community-driven.

name: Cameron Wolfe
domain: deep learning research / LLM internals / education
bio: AI researcher and author of the 'Deep (Learning) Focus' newsletter on Substack. Writes technical deep dives on LLM architectures and training that are among the clearest available.

name: Piotr Skalski
bio: Research Advocate at Roboflow. Runs the blog 'Roboflow Notebooks'. Extremely active on LinkedIn and Twitter with hands-on computer vision tutorials.

name: Max Woolf
bio: Data scientist and author. Writes detailed explorations of LLM prompting, structured generation, and Python data workflows. Known for technically rigorous blog posts.

name: Significant Gravitas
bio: Creator of Auto-GPT, one of the first viral autonomous AI agent frameworks. Very engaged on GitHub and Discord. Championing open agentic AI frameworks.

name: João Moura
bio: Founder of CrewAI. Built the popular multi-agent LLM orchestration framework. Very active on social media and enthusiastic about agentic AI.

name: Andy Matuschak
bio: Researcher at the intersection of software design and cognitive science. Creator of the Mnemonic medium. Writes deeply on memory, spaced repetition, and how software can help people learn.

name: Michael Nielsen
bio: Researcher and writer. Co-creator of Quantum Country, the mnemonic essay on quantum computing. Writes on memory, deep learning, and learning complex topics. Very accessible.

name: Piotr Wozniak
bio: Creator of SuperMemo and pioneer of the spaced repetition algorithm (SM-2). Has researched and written about memory and learning for decades. Open to engaging with developers building SRS tools.

name: Damien Elmes
bio: Creator of Anki, the world's most popular open-source spaced repetition software. Actively maintains the project and engages with developers in its ecosystem.

name: Will McGugan
domain: Python CLI / terminal UIs / developer tools
bio: Creator of Rich and Textual. Builds the most beautiful terminal UIs in Python. Very active on Twitter and GitHub, always enthusiastic about Python tooling.

name: Charlie Marsh
bio: Founder of Astral. Creator of Ruff, the blazing-fast Python linter and formatter written in Rust, and uv, the ultra-fast package manager. Reshaping the Python tooling ecosystem.

name: Łukasz Langa
bio: Python core developer and creator of Black, the uncompromising code formatter. Python Ambassador at Meta. Very active in the Python community.

name: Samuel Colvin
bio: Creator of Pydantic, the backbone of most LLM structured-output frameworks. Very active on GitHub and Twitter. His library powers FastAPI and the entire LLM tooling stack.

name: Sebastián Ramírez
bio: Creator of FastAPI and Typer. His frameworks power a huge proportion of modern ML API servers. Known for exceptional documentation and GitHub responsiveness.

name: Al Sweigart
bio: Author of 'Automate the Boring Stuff with Python'. Makes all his books freely available online. Passionate advocate for Python accessibility and automation.

name: Julia Evans
bio: Creator of the beloved 'Wizard Zines' series. Makes complex systems topics (DNS, strace, gdb) accessible through hand-drawn comics. Extremely approachable and active blogger.

name: Xe Iaso
domain: Go / Nix / distributed systems / AI experiments
bio: Prolific technical blogger at Fly.io. Writes on Go, Nix, AI experiments, and systems engineering. Known for humor, technical depth, and very frequent high-quality posts.

name: Victoria Krakovna
bio: Research scientist at DeepMind AI Safety. Maintains the famous specification gaming examples list. Writes clearly about reward hacking and goal misspecification.

name: Evan Hubinger
domain: AI safety / deceptive alignment / inner alignment
bio: Researcher at Anthropic. Author of the influential 'Risks from Learned Optimization' paper on deceptive alignment. Writes clearly about inner alignment failure modes.

name: Rohin Shah
domain: AI safety / value alignment / agent foundations
bio: Alignment researcher at DeepMind. Author of the Alignment Newsletter, providing accessible weekly summaries of AI safety research for practitioners.

name: Dan Hendrycks
domain: AI safety / ML robustness / MMLU benchmark
bio: Director of the Center for AI Safety. Creator of MMLU, CIFAR-10-C, and other key benchmarks. Prolific researcher on robustness, safety, and AI risk. Open to collaboration.

name: Aurélien Géron
bio: Author of 'Hands-On Machine Learning with Scikit-Learn, Keras, and TensorFlow', one of the bestselling ML books. Very active on Twitter and GitHub.

name: Santiago Valdarrama
bio: ML engineer and creator of highly visual ML educational content. One of the largest ML educational accounts on Twitter and LinkedIn. Very active and community-focused.

name: Aleksa Gordić
bio: Creator of 'The AI Epiphany' YouTube channel. Former DeepMind intern. Explains cutting-edge ML papers with exceptional clarity. Very active with a growing community.

name: Lee Robinson
bio: VP of Developer Experience at Vercel. Builds tutorials and demos for Next.js and AI SDK integrations. One of the most followed developer advocates on Twitter.

name: Josh Comeau
bio: Creator of joshwcomeau.com and 'CSS for JavaScript Developers'. Makes the most interactive and visually rich programming tutorials on the web. Very approachable.

name: Anthony Fu
bio: Open-source developer at NuxtLabs. Creator of VueUse, UnoCSS, and dozens of widely-used tools. Extremely prolific open-source contributor and community builder.

name: Peter Levels
domain: indie hacking / solo building / AI apps
bio: Creator of Nomad List, Remote OK, and several viral AI apps. Built multiple profitable products solo. Prolific Twitter poster and advocate for simple, fast building with AI.

name: Marc Lou
domain: AI SaaS / rapid prototyping / indie hacking
bio: Prolific indie hacker who ships AI-powered SaaS products in days. Creator of ShipFast boilerplate. Very active on Twitter with a large engaged audience of builders.

name: Lenny Rachitsky
bio: Former Airbnb PM. Runs Lenny's Newsletter, one of the most widely-read product management publications. Covers AI product development and growth. Very community-focused.

name: Tri Dao
bio: Lead author of FlashAttention and Mamba (SSM). His work on efficient attention mechanisms directly shapes every modern LLM training stack. Princeton PhD.

name: Albert Gu
domain: state space models / sequence modeling / Mamba
bio: Stanford PhD and co-creator of S4 and Mamba state-space model architectures. His work challenges transformer dominance in long-sequence modeling.

name: Cassie Kozyrkov
domain: decision intelligence / data science / AI education
bio: Former Chief Decision Scientist at Google. Coined 'decision intelligence'. Writes accessible explainers about AI, statistics, and decision-making for very large audiences.

name: Nicholas Carlini
bio: Research scientist at Google DeepMind. One of the leading researchers on adversarial examples, LLM extraction attacks, and model memorization. Very publicly engaged on Twitter.

name: Florian Tramèr
bio: Professor at ETH Zürich. Researches adversarial attacks, differential privacy, and AI security. Very active on Twitter sharing security and ML research.

name: Shreya Rajpal
domain: LLM guardrails / output validation / AI reliability
bio: Founder of Guardrails AI. Building open-source infrastructure for LLM output validation and reliability. Very active in the LLM engineering community.

name: Olivier Grisel
bio: Core contributor to Scikit-Learn. Software engineer at Inria. Has shaped how Python ML tools are built for over a decade. Accessible through GitHub.

name: Tim Rocktäschel
bio: Professor at UCL and research scientist at Meta AI. Works on neural-symbolic integration and RL. Writes accessibly about agent reasoning and memory architectures.

name: Bernhard Schölkopf
domain: causal ML / kernel methods / representation learning
bio: Director at Max Planck Institute for Intelligent Systems. Pioneer of SVMs and causal representation learning. One of the most cited ML researchers globally.

name: Thorsten Ball
bio: Author of 'Writing An Interpreter In Go' and 'Writing A Compiler In Go'. Very readable books that demystify language implementation. Engaged with the developer community.

name: Pekka Enberg
bio: CTO at Turso (libSQL). Former database kernel researcher. Enthusiastic about Rust and SQLite-based distributed systems. Very active on Twitter.

name: Corey Quinn
bio: Cloud economist at the Duckbill Group. Hosts the 'Screaming in the Cloud' podcast. Known for irreverent takes on AWS and cloud architecture. Widely followed.

name: Predrag Gruevski
bio: Creator of cargo-semver-checks, a Rust tool for automated SemVer compatibility checking. Thoughtful writer on API design and developer tooling.

name: Joel Grus
bio: Author of 'Data Science from Scratch'. Former AI researcher at Allen Institute. Known for contrarian but thoughtful takes on ML tooling and Jupyter notebooks.

name: Peter Wang
bio: Co-founder and CEO of Anaconda. One of the people who made scientific Python mainstream. Champions open-source data science. Very active in the community.

name: Venelin Valkov
bio: ML engineer and educator. Creator of Curiousily.com with hundreds of practical ML tutorials covering LLM fine-tuning, NLP, and time-series prediction.

name: Brian Okken
bio: Author of 'Python Testing with pytest'. Hosts the 'Python Bytes' and 'Test & Code' podcasts. Deeply embedded in the Python community and very approachable.

name: Tanner Linsley
bio: Creator of TanStack (React Query, TanStack Table, Router). His libraries are used by millions of React developers. Very active on Twitter and Discord.

name: Arvid Kahl
bio: Author of 'The Embedded Entrepreneur' and 'Zero to Sold'. Educator for indie founders building sustainable software businesses. Active community builder.

name: Claudio Jolowicz
bio: Author of the 'Hypermodern Python' guide. Core contributor to Nox and the Python packaging ecosystem. Deep expertise in modern Python tooling and project setup.

name: Luis Serrano
domain: ML education / linear algebra / intuition-first teaching
bio: Former Google Brain researcher and ML educator. YouTube channel 'Serrano.Academy' explains ML concepts with geometric intuition. Very accessible and approachable.

name: Quentin Anthony
domain: LLM training / distributed training / ML systems
bio: Research engineer at EleutherAI. Expert in distributed training for large language models. Writes about the systems challenges of training frontier open LLMs.

name: Adam Jermyn
bio: Researcher at Anthropic working on AI safety and interpretability. Writes clearly about model internals and safety research. Responds to thoughtful outreach.

name: Sheng Shen
bio: PhD researcher at UC Berkeley working on efficient LLM inference and quantization. Co-author of GPTQ and other widely-used compression methods.

name: Yujia Bao
domain: NLP research / few-shot learning / agentic systems
bio: PhD researcher at MIT CSAIL. Works on meta-learning, few-shot NLP, and emergent behaviors in LLMs. Active on academic Twitter with accessible explanations.

name: Søren Rasmussen
bio: Core contributor and evangelist at CrewAI. Focuses on multi-agent orchestration patterns and LLM workflow automation. Active on GitHub and Discord.

name: Ben Tossell
bio: Founder of Makerpad (acquired by Zapier). Writes about no-code AI tools, automation, and building businesses with AI. Very enthusiastic and easy to reach.

name: Andrei Bursuc
bio: AI researcher at Valeo. Prolific Twitter poster sharing CV and self-supervised learning papers. Maintains a curated reading list followed by many researchers.

name: Harm de Vries
domain: code LLMs / software engineering AI / research
bio: Research scientist at ServiceNow. Works on LLMs for code generation and software engineering automation. Writes about AI coding assistants and agentic code tools.

name: Samy Bengio
bio: Research scientist at Google Brain. Works on fundamental questions of generalization and learning. Has published seminal papers on adversarial examples and learning theory.

name: Johannes Messner
bio: ML engineer at Cohere. Writes extensively about RAG, embedding models, and production NLP. Active in the LLM application developer community.

name: Zico Kolter
bio: Professor at CMU. Works on adversarial robustness, energy-based models, and differentiable programming. Writes about implicit layers and equilibrium networks in deep learning.

name: Guo Peiyuan (PY)
domain: open-source LLMs / ModelScope / Chinese AI ecosystem
bio: Core engineer at Alibaba's ModelScope platform. Works on open-sourcing Chinese LLMs and building accessible ML infrastructure for the broader developer ecosystem.

name: Akshay Pachaar
domain: agentic AI / LLM tooling / developer education
bio: AI Developer Advocate. Creates hands-on tutorials on building agentic LLM pipelines, tool use, and function calling. Very active on LinkedIn and YouTube.

name: Elvis Yu
bio: Co-founder of Towhee, an open-source multimodal ML pipeline framework. Makes embedding pipelines for video, audio, and text accessible to all developers.

name: Harsimrat Sandhawalia
bio: Founder of Mixpeek, a multimodal retrieval API. Builds and writes about video, audio, and image search pipelines. Active in the developer AI community.

name: Marvin Hagemeister
bio: Core maintainer of Preact and Deno's standard library. Prolific open-source contributor across the JavaScript ecosystem. Active on GitHub and Twitter.

name: Quentin Gallouédec
bio: Research engineer at Hugging Face working on reinforcement learning and robotics. Lead developer of lerobot, the open-source robot learning library.

name: Nikhil Suresh
bio: Writer and engineer behind the 'Hate Data' blog. Writes entertainingly about the realities of data engineering, Python, and ML in production. Very popular and approachable.

name: Russ Cox
bio: Lead developer of the Go programming language at Google. One of the most careful and thoughtful communicators about programming language design. Accessible through GitHub.

name: Filippo Valsorda
bio: Maintainer of Go's standard library cryptography. Former security lead at Cloudflare. Writes clearly about Go internals, cryptography, and software supply chain security.

name: Marius Schulz
bio: Author of the 'TypeScript Evolution' article series on Flavio Copes' blog and his own. Writes extremely clear technical deep dives on TypeScript features.

name: Riccardo Mori
bio: Indie developer and writer. Builds and writes about small, focused software products. Very approachable voice in the indie developer community.

name: Tim Berglund
domain: Apache Kafka / distributed systems / developer education
bio: Senior Director at Confluent. Technical educator and conference speaker on distributed systems, Kafka, and data streaming. Very approachable and active in the community.

name: Alice Ryhl
bio: Core contributor to Tokio, the async Rust runtime. Writes authoritative deep dives on async programming patterns in Rust. Very active on the Rust community forums.

name: Tyler Neely
bio: Creator of sled, a high-performance embedded database in Rust. Writes transparently about database internals, storage engines, and the challenges of open-source sustainability.

name: David Tolnay
bio: Author of serde, syn, and dozens of foundational Rust crates. One of the most respected Rust library authors. GitHub-first communicator.

name: Randy Olson
bio: Research scientist and creator of TPOT (AutoML). Prolific data visualization blogger and open-source contributor. Known for accessible data science writing.

name: Tim Head
bio: Core Jupyter developer and Binder maintainer. Facilitates reproducible scientific computing. Active in the open-source scientific Python community.

name: Evan Schwartz
bio: Co-creator of the Interledger Protocol. Researcher on distributed payment systems and open financial protocols. Approachable and excited about novel system architectures.

name: Dario Floreano
bio: Professor and director of the Laboratory of Intelligent Systems at EPFL. Pioneer of evolutionary robotics and bio-inspired AI. Open to collaboration with practitioners.

name: Paul Everitt
bio: Developer Advocate at JetBrains focused on Python and JavaScript tooling. PyCharm community leader and prolific tutorial author. Very approachable and helpful.

name: Timothy Crosley
bio: Creator of isort and hug. Prolific Python open-source author focused on developer experience and code quality tooling.

name: Bill Doerrfeld
domain: AI APIs / developer tools / agentic systems
bio: Editor-in-chief at Nordic APIs. Writes about AI APIs, agent orchestration, and developer ecosystems. Easy to reach and open to collaboration on agentic tooling topics.

name: Lior Bar David
domain: LLM evaluation / AI product / developer tools
bio: CEO at Metal (vector search startup). Writes frequently about practical LLM evaluation, product-building with AI, and agentic patterns. Enthusiastic community builder.

name: Josh Batson
bio: Research scientist at Anthropic working on mechanistic interpretability and neuroscience-inspired approaches to understanding neural networks.

name: Tanishq Abraham
bio: Former fast.ai researcher and founder of MedAI. Works on applying deep learning to medical imaging. Youngest researcher at UCSF. Active in the ML community.

name: Thomas Capelle
bio: ML engineer at Weights & Biases. Writes and streams tutorials on experiment tracking, model training, and MLOps best practices. Very community-focused.

name: Johno Whitaker
bio: Researcher at Answer.AI. Expert in diffusion models and generative image techniques. Co-creator of several popular notebooks on generative AI. Very approachable.

name: Hugo Larochelle
domain: ML research / Google Brain Montreal / education
bio: Research scientist at Google Brain Montreal and professor at Université de Montréal. Created one of the first widely-used ML MOOCs. Very active in academic ML community.

name: Gabriel Peyré
domain: optimal transport / computational maths / ML theory
bio: Research director at CNRS and ENS Paris. Works on optimal transport and its applications to ML. Writes highly accessible math threads on Twitter (@gabrielpeyre).

name: Fabian Pedregosa
bio: Research engineer at Google Brain. Core Scikit-Learn contributor and author of foundational ML optimization papers. Accessible via GitHub and Twitter.

name: Shajen Debnath
bio: Post Graduate Teacher (PGT) of Information Technology at Jawahar Navodaya Vidyalaya (JNV), Tripura, India, for 6+ years. Experienced Java developer with a background in the IT services industry. Holds an MCA from ITM University, Gwalior. Skilled in Python, Java SE, Android, Struts, C++, and HTML. Has built creative tech demos — including a badminton game using OpenCV and Python. Passionate about finding practical ways to address students' learning needs. Connected since May 2026; likely an early follower and enthusiast of Sam's project.
